High-performance Dapper extension methods for offset-based pagination (Skip/Take), sorting, and SQL parameterization.

Cursor pagination relies on unique record pointers rather than numerical offsets. The client requests a specific window of data by sending an opaque reference token (`Cursor` / `After`) representing the boundary of the last seen record, alongside the number of records to fetch (`Take` / `PageSize`).

Offset pagination relies on numerical page offsets. The client requests a specific window of data by sending the number of records to skip (`Skip` / `First`) and the number of records to fetch (`Take` / `PageSize`).
Provides shared core contracts, models, and abstractions for pagination, dynamic multi-condition filtering, sorting rules, etc.
